facts.fact: After a November 2023 POPIA assessment the Information Regulator issued the basic education department a notice not to publish the 2024 matric results in newspapers; the department kept publishing exam numbers.
The Regulator lost three bids in the Pretoria high court to stop newspaper publication of matric results and has taken the case to the Supreme Court of Appeal (reported 17 August 2026).
The document says Popia was signed into law in 2013 and that the department stopped publishing learners' surnames in 2014 after Popia was established; it does not state a commencement date.
